# Error-taxonomy pins. Unlike the code snapshot (frozen: codes never
# change), this file tracks the error->error taxonomy mappings.
# Each row maps a crypto error to its backend category; the
# observable ReturnCode is unchanged by the mapping.
[encode]
CryptoUnsupported = BackendUnsupported
CryptoBadKey = BackendBadKey
CryptoAuthFailed = BackendAuthFailed
CryptoFailed = BackendNative
